mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `USER` ( USER_NAME, USER_EMAIL, USER_PASSWORD_HASH, USER_NICKNAME, USER_PHONE_NUMBER ) VALUES ( #{authSignUpRequestDTO.userName}, #{authSignUpRequestDTO.userEmail}, #{authSignUpRequestDTO.userPassword}, #{authSignUpRequestDTO.userNickname}, #{authSignUpRequestDTO.phoneNumber} )
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `USER` WHERE USER_PHONE_NUMBER = #{phoneNumber} AND USER_STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN' )
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `USER` WHERE USER_EMAIL = #{email} AND USER_STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN' )
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `USER` WHERE USER_NICKNAME = #{nickName} AND USER_STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN' )
